doc: A tree's skeleton: branches, wind bones, break pieces, and foliage anchors, plus the request that made it so the body and colour agree.

fields.name: stump_radius
fields.doc: Radius of the colliding stump (the conformance), metres.

fields.name: crown_base
fields.doc: Height where branches start: the top of the colliding stump; everything above is visual.

fields.name: cut
fields.doc: Height of the break cut, metres.

fields.name: branches
fields.doc: Stem first, then limbs, twigs, and sprigs.

fields.name: bones
fields.doc: Wind bones; bone 0 is the stump.

fields.name: pieces
fields.doc: Break pieces; 0 is the stump, 1 the log, then limbs.
